verdicts.opus: B and D both traced the real series, but B went further. It decomposed critical vs total, read lift to separate distinctive places (Ukraine, Russia) from background ones (US), and surfaced the India–Pakistan (Operation Sindoor) and Middle East strands the question hinges on, with dated headlines that carry urls. D was accurate in outline but generic, and it misread the censor as applying to May. A and C were honest that they had no data, so they offer a decision-maker nothing measured.
verdicts.gpt: D is the strongest decision brief: it answers volume, tone and place coverage with traced figures, a reproducible monthly export, and concrete headline examples while bounding what those measures mean. C has richer breakdowns, but its reversed March/April peak values and unsupported geography detail weaken confidence; neither database-backed deliverable charts the requested tone comparison.
